t](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/delete-a-project-and-everything-scoped-to-it.md): IRREVERSIBLE, and it cascades:
project access grants and invites, the mapped workspace and its memberships, every saved server in the project (each soft-deleted
asynchronously, which also rotates the host configs that referenced it), and hosted tasks. Requires project admin. The request bo
dy must be…\n- [Update project metadata](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/update-project-metadata.md): Updates name,
description, icon or visibility. Requires project admin; a non-member gets `404` rather than `403`, so the response never confirm
s that a project exists. The project's server map is not updatable here. See the per-server routes.\n- [What the caller may do her
e](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/what-the-caller-may-do-here.md): Role, gate state, plan limits and a set of deri
ved booleans, so an agent on a static surface can check before it acts instead of attempting a write and reading the failure.\n- [
Save a server into a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md): Creates a saved MCP
server and responds `201` with its detail. This is the provisioning entry point: every eval, host and environment route addresses
servers that were created here. Names are unique per workspace, so a clash responds `409` rather than silently returning the exist
ing row. Secret-bear…\n- [List a server's revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A
saved server's stored revisions, newest first. A revision is a capture of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever t
hey change on a connect, an eval run or a chat session. Reads stored data and never connects to the server, so it works for stdio
servers too. A server the caller cannot…\n- [Get one server revision](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-server
-revision.md): One stored revision: every tool's definition and the server info the server reported. `droppedFields` lists paths s
torage dropped for size; their values are unknown, not absent.\n- [Diff two server revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/servers/diff-two-server-revisions.md): Compares `from` (default: the revision before) with `revisionNumber`: tools added and rem
oved with their definitions, tools changed with the fields that moved and both definitions, and each changed server info field wit
h both values. Revision 1 has nothing before it, so diffing it needs `from`. A fi…\n- [Get one saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/servers/get-one-saved-server.md): The server's detail, projected toward the hosted shape. Secrets are never inclu
ded: `hasClientSecret` reports presence only. A server id from another project reads as `404`.\n- [Delete a saved server](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/delete-a-saved-server.md): Soft-deletes the server and schedules its cascade: MCP Apps views
, hosted OAuth credentials, encrypted secret objects, and a rotation of every host config that referenced it. The cascade is ASYNC
HRONOUS, so a read immediately after this call may still observe the row. The request body must be empty.\n- [Update a saved serve
r](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/update-a-saved-server.md): Sparse update: omitted fields are unchanged. Renaming
re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`409` on a clash). Editing a server shared as an OAuth connection requires project admin. `cli
entSecret` and `clearClientSecret` are mutually exclusive.\n- [List a project's server groups](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/environments/list-a-projects-server-groups.md): A server group is an immutable snapshot of a set of saved servers. Pinning one
on an environment is what keeps a run off its host's live server list, so a composed run keeps testing the servers it was composed
against even after the shared host is edited.\n- [Snapshot servers into a server group](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/env
ironments/snapshot-servers-into-a-server-group.md): Creates a server group holding exactly the given servers and responds `201` wi
th its detail. Groups are create-only: there is no update route, because an editable group would reintroduce the drift that pinnin
g exists to prevent. Names are unique per project, so a clash responds `409`. Servers must b…\n- [List a project's environments](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-environments.md): The project environments saved in the project.
Archived environments are excluded unless `includeArchived=true`: you need that to find one to restore.\n- [Check what this deplo
yment's environment surface supports](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/check-what-this-deployments-environment-s
urface-supports.md): Report which environment features this MCPJam deployment accepts. Call it before sending a model override: cl
ients ship independently of the platform, and a field an older deployment does not know is a hard validation error there rather th
an a silently ignored one. A deployment too old to answer rep…\n- [Show one environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/env
ironments/show-one-environment.md): Read one environment, including the `revision` you pass back as `expectedRevision` when writin
g to it.\n- [Preview what an environment resolves to](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/preview-what-an-environme
nt-resolves-to.md): Resolve an environment to the exact execution inputs a run would use right now: the host's current config and
the closed server set. Returns 409 when the environment cannot currently produce a runnable configuration; `details.code` carries
the specific reason (`ENV_NO_SERVERS`, `ENV_HOST_MISSING`, ……\n- [Get or create an unnamed environment for a composed stack](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/get-or-create-an-unnamed-environment-for-a-composed-stack.md): GET-OR-CREATE an UNNA
MED, content-addressed environment for a composed stack: a host plus an optional server group and model override. The environment
does not appear in the project's list of named environments.\n- [Archive an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/env
ironments/archive-an-environment.md): Archive an environment. It stops being selectable for runs and frees its name for a new one,
but the row is kept and can be restored: this is why archive is a sub-action rather than a DELETE. Requires `expectedRevision`: t
he revision you last read. If the environment changed since, the write is reje…\n- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-projects-scenarios.md): The studies published from this project: name, access mode, attached se
rvers, and share link. Read-only.\n- [Publish an environment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/publi
sh-an-environment-for-user-testing.md): PUT, not POST, because publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publishing
an already-published environment returns the existing one rather than minting a second. `created` says which happened.\n- [Unpubl
ish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Unpublishing
does not require User Testing access, so an organization that loses access can still take a live study down.\n- [Get a study](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, system prompt, tool-
approval policy, attached servers, share link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over its latest analyzed w
indow.\n- [Update a scenario](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or it
s exposure, but not both in one call. **Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operations upstream, and appl
ying them in sequence could leave the study live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scenarios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project members only: this route is de
liberately absent from the guest allowlist, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' sessions.\n- [Get a session tra
nscript](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcript, paged. Tool payload
